bearaby-cotton-napper: Breathable weight that stays put; hard to wash, and toes catch.
bearaby-tree-napper: The one weighted blanket hot sleepers use in summer; an odd smell.
brooklinen-luxe-sateen-core-sheet-set: Soft sheets that last years; a few tore early.
buffy-cloud-comforter: Soft and long-lasting; several still sleep hot under it.
casper-original: Seven to ten years of good sleep for several; some sag later.
casper-original-hybrid: Soft yet supportive for years; it dips in the middle for a few.
coop-original-adjustable-pillow: Adjustable fill to suit you; the foam clumps or flattens in time.
eight-sleep-pod-4: Lasting cooling and comfort; leaks, failures and app woes for some.
leesa-legend-hybrid: Plush, supportive and cool; softer than expected for some.
macks-pillow-soft-silicone-putty-ear-plu: Comfortable, effective putty plugs; they need frequent replacing.
manta-sleep-mask: Blocks all light, even for side sleepers; stiff cups need break-in.
nolah-evolution: Heavier and side sleepers praise it; some sag within two years.
pillow-cube-side-cube: Keeps side sleepers' necks pain-free and holds shape; poor on back.
plank-firm-luxe: Flippable, so you pick the firmness; it sags at the hips over time.
purple-harmony-pillow: Cool, supportive and worth it to some; flat after a year for some.
purple-mattress: Six to ten years of cool sleep for many; some sag after a few years.
purple-restorepremier: Comfortable and cool for some; it dips in the middle and is heavy.
purple-softstretch-sheet-set: Deep pockets and stretch keep them in place; pilling for some.
purplerenew: Especially comfortable for side sleepers; hot for one.
saatva-latex-hybrid: Springy and firm with some give; firmer than expected at first.
saatva-loom-leaf: Holds up for years; too firm or sagging early for a couple.
soundcore-sleep-a20: Reliable out of the case and a cheaper stand-in for Ozlo buds.
tempur-neck-pillow: The only pillow that supports the neck for many; too hard for one.
